depiction_rules.notes: D034: use the ordinary elder mendicant disguise only in its scene plan. D035 S007: show the final-battle form with exactly ten distinct heads attached to one coherent torso and exactly two arms; no head is severed.

visual_bible.face_and_form: D034 mendicant disguise: one ordinary-looking elder with two arms, plain ochre robe and humble bowl, with no crown or multiplied heads. D035 S007 final battle: one coherent kingly body with exactly ten distinct heads in a crown-like row and exactly two attached arms; the plan specifies this intentional form.
visual_bible.anatomy: ordinary humanlike cast has two arms and two legs; mythic species anatomy follows the explicit character contract

never: no extra or missing limbs or heads unless explicit scene contract calls for a mythic form
no disconnected hands, fused bodies or cloned characters
no glossy shading, reflective gold, readable text or outer border
